N096 owner results

The owner issued 2,886 point forecasts across 26 streams for 111 upcoming games. One ExtraTrees total-points model refit on 1,815 games after its training matrix and transforms changed. Seven other joint champion recipes retained their preceding fit. The job ledger recorded one new fit, 217 reused jobs and zero failed jobs.

The three original Week 10 cards were selected at 12:01:24 a.m. Pacific on Saturday, November 14. The 50/50 line-mixture cards followed at 12:01:39 a.m. Pacific. Each evaluated 26 sides from 13 eligible games before the 4 p.m. Pacific deadline.

Do NFL key margins improve spread probabilities?

Each of nine model versions learned how far to move its prediction toward the contest spread and how much probability to assign to common NFL winning margins. Nine shuffled-outcome controls underwent the same fit. The evaluation covers 1,593 held-out model/game observations across 541 distinct games. Lower scores indicate better probability forecasts.

2026 common gamesGamesOriginal ATS Brier50/50 line mixtureKey marginsIndependent lineShuffled labels

ExtraTrees750.57720.56040.53930.55490.5456
HistGradientBoosting750.56930.56330.53840.55490.5481

All three key-margin forecasts beat the independent official-line baseline on the 75 common 2026 games. CatBoost also trailed its shuffled control. Under 50/35/15 weighting on comparable calendar weeks, the difference versus the official-line baseline was small for all three families. Each paired 95% interval included zero.

How did the models compare with observed exchange prices?

The retrospective comparison matched 219 settled winner and margin contracts across 73 games. Each exchange-stamped one-minute interval closed by the reconstructed forecast cutoff, one hour before kickoff, and lay within two minutes of that cutoff. Price observations were retrieved later. The table compares forecasts with the contemporaneous bid/ask midpoint. Lower Brier scores are better.

All 39 current contracts had matching rules, a fee basis and two-sided depth. For 28, a post-issue minute price and observed book also matched within five minutes. The live book lacked exchange-generated timestamps for individual quote changes. No trade or historical fill was recorded.

Did injury and rotation information improve the margin?

Two registered studies compared 225 newly fitted parameter sets with team-only and shuffled controls. Snap continuity covered all 707 completed games across the three seasons and 111 dated upcoming games. The separate injury study could match dated reports to 284 games in 2024 and 13 upcoming games. Missing report timestamps prevented historical evaluation for 2025 and 2026.

StudySeasonGamesPersonnel MAETeam-only MAEControl MAEMarket MAE
Prior four games’ snap continuity202613710.42110.36510.4669.449
Dated injury and replacement workload202428410.70010.86310.9569.736

The 2024 injury result beat the team-only comparison by 0.163 margin points per game. The 2026 snap-continuity result trailed team-only by 0.056 points. The recorded market was more accurate in both cohorts. The results do not establish a causal scoring value for a named absence.

How did the separate total-points models compare with exchange prices?

Seventy-three settled total contracts matched an exchange-stamped bid/ask minute ending by the one-hour pregame cutoff, within a two-minute trailing window. How did the recovered historical models grade?

Four of five historical labels were linked to their original research. Across 16 games, 183 preserved pregame research predictions could be graded against the final scores. The 2026 winner improvement was 0.00469 Brier on 118 decisive games. Its three-season weighted interval included zero. The book scored better on season-weighted margin. Only part of the historical book data had verified pregame possession. No recovered historical label or retrospective fit earned promotion.

What survived the 201-feature ridge reconstruction?

The recovered original feature builder matched all 21,411 stored game/target rows across 7,137 games. Seventeen additional finals qualified for fresh fitting. Winner, margin and total models produced 333 new research forecasts for 111 dated games. The winner fit used 7,138 decisive training games. The two continuous targets used 7,154 games each.

All three original coefficient arrays and 48 original predictions reproduced bit for bit. The interpreter and registered estimator libraries matched the original. The system C library minor version differed, so all three runs carry a separate portability-research label. The preceding model weights and issue history remain preserved. Future finals are needed to grade these new forecasts.

What are the chances of reaching three contest points?

Expected points add across the five games. The probability of reaching a three-point target depends on how outcomes move together. Can total-score models assign a probability to every observed score?

How does adding the official spread change the picks?

The N096 experiment combined each original probability distribution equally with a reference centered on the official Circa line. Across matched weeks 3–9, the three pooled distributions improved CRPS over their original model. The same model shifted to the official line had lower CRPS than its pool for every family. A separate baseline fitted to historical official-line residuals also had lower ATS Brier than each pool on the weighted comparable weeks. The 50% / 35% / 15% policy gives the greatest weight to 2026. These are historical reconstructions scored on matched games.

In reconstructed 2026 weeks 4–8, these five-card policies scored ExtraTrees 10.5/25, CatBoost 14/25, HistGB 9.5/25. Historical possession before the weekly deadline is unproved. The experiment produced 39 current margin distributions and 117 current contract/model mappings. No trade or production promotion was recorded.

Does a rolling six-model total improve on equal weights?

The original challenger study fitted 47 chronological weighting policies and 47 label-shuffled controls. The N096 owner recovered all 94 parameter sets. It used up to 52 weeks of prior outcomes and generated 585 historical reconstructions and 111 prospective point forecasts. The equal-weight improvement in 2026 was 0.032 points per game, with a paired 95% interval of −0.037 to +0.144. The shuffled control scored slightly better. The archived schedule total had lower average error across the 122 matched 2026 games. The paired interval for market MAE minus challenger MAE was −1.427 to −0.138. The source supplied no contemporaneous quote timestamp.

What did team offense and defense add?

The independent team-strength challenger fitted scoring regressions for the two teams, using earlier games to estimate opponent-adjusted team and venue effects. Its initial development produced 159 new supervised fits and reused six. The N096 owner recovered all 165 scheduled fit results. Across 707 held-out games, it beat the venue-only and shuffled-team margin controls under the 50% / 35% / 15% season policy. The archived market spread and total both scored better than the challenger. The 111 current point estimates remain private research forecasts.

How stable were the selections?

All three models selected Carolina +2.5, Tennessee +10.5 and Arizona +9.5. Eight different sides appeared on the three cards. The models favored the same side on eight of 13 games. For every eligible side, the three reported marginal intervals overlap. Shared intervals do not quantify uncertainty in differences between models.
